label: The intuitionist theory's commitments are jointly satisfiable together with the comparison's open…
meaning: The intuitionist rival to STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE is consistent: a concrete model satisfies its three sourced commitments together with the comparison's open premises STMT-ASSERTION-REQUIRES-PROOF-INTUITIONISM and STMT-TRUTH-IS-PROVABILITY-INTUITIONISM, which bind-check matches to the conjuncts of IntuitionistTheoryConsistent (∃ s, Intuitionist s ∧ AssertionRequiresProofReading s.Proved s.Asserts ∧ TruthIsProvabilityReading s.Proved). So the rival does not lose on consistency; the comparison turns on coverage. Answer map (also in TruthCore/Comparison/ExcludedMiddle.lean): Q-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE: withheld, not denied (INTUITIONISM-ENTAILS-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE-WITHHELD). Q-TRUTH: truth is provability (STMT-TRUTH-IS-PROVABILITY-INTUITIONISM, the comparison's open premise, strengthening the entry's primacy of proof STMT-PROOF-NOT-TRUTH-CENTRAL-INTUITIONISM), against Aristotle's truth by composition. Q-FIRST-MOVER: the intuitionist who grants the prima via premises grants STMT-FIRST-UNMOVED-MOVER-CANNOT-BE-LACKING (the prima via result is constructive) but withholds the instance STMT-FIRST-UNMOVED-MOVER-EXISTS-OR-NOT, so whether there is a first mover is unexplained. Q-ONE-FIRST-MOVER: the identity instance is withheld, unexplained. Q-DECIDABLE-CASES (Aristotle's odd numbers): agreement. Existence, cosmic order, mind, morality and the historical evidence: intuitionism gives no answer of its own, unexplained. What the model does not show: that intuitionism is true, or that its answer to Q-TRUTH covers non-mathematical propositions.
